title: Vanishing for even functions and odd sets
statement: Let $n\ge 0$, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube satisfying $f(-x)=f(x)$ for every input $x$, and let $S$ be a coordinate set of odd cardinality. Then the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the sign cube of dimension $n$
$f$ is even under simultaneous sign reversal
